prompt: Sparks from two sword blades clashing, pixel art, plays once, about 0.25 seconds. A bright white-yellow flash at the centre with five to six short golden spark lines radiating outward, shrinking and fading quickly. Colours: white, pale yellow, gold. message: A 32x32 one-shot clash spark that plays for 0.25 seconds (7 frames at 28 fps): a bright white-yellow flash at the centre with six short gold spark lines that spin slightly, shrink and fade out fast.
